Name: (CP) Fio's Hair Down Sam
Author: PocoFio
Description:
Ever since my character married Sam, I've always been curious about what he looks like with his hair down.
I mean, we're married and living under the same roof now—I should be able to see him without his hair styled!
Ta-da! And so this mod was born!


[size=4][b][u]Features[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]✨New Portraits & Sprites[/b][/size][/color]
Adds new portraits and sprites for hair-down Sam.
Adds 2 pajamas for Sam's sleeping sprite.

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]⚒️Portrait Fix[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Slightly fixes a few frames of vanilla portraits.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]⚙️Customized Chance[/size][/b][/color]
Customize the daily chance for Sam to have his hair down in config. Default: 20% chance per day.
[i]Note: His hair is always down during winter and bedtime.[/i]


[color=#d4d4d8][u][b][size=4]Plans[/size][/b][/u][/color]
NO plans for compatibility with any other seasonal mods, as it would be too much work to complete.
